Agent 14/35 — load-transfer phase timing. Trace sprung roll, unsprung motion, per-wheel Fz and lateral force after a steering step at 40/70/100 km/h. Look for load transfer arriving in the wrong order, double-counting, or excessive delay that could cause initial understeer. Respect canonical FL/FR/RL/RR and sign conventions. Do not compensate with tire grip. Add causal-order/symmetry tests if any defect is found.
